title: 🗳️ Top of the Ticket: Republicans Ahead, Margins Vary
text: Every October poll has Donalds and Moody leading. UNF (Oct 12-19, n=1,471) has Governor 49-47 and Senate 49-45, inside or near the margin; Stetson and Mason-Dixon show double-digit GOP leads; St. Pete Polls had both races tied. Pollsmax averages: Donalds +5, Moody +6.5. The CFO race is the only true statewide toss-up.

title: 📬 Early Vote: Pinellas Democrats Narrowly Ahead
text: Statewide through Oct 27, 3.52M ballots are in: REP 40.1%, DEM 39.1%, NPA 20.7%; Democrats lead mail by about 123k and Republicans lead in-person by about 158k. In Pinellas through Oct 26, about 167,600 ballots had been cast (129k mail, 38k in person), with Democrats at 66,250 and Republicans at 64,092 per unofficial trackers.

title: 🌴 St. Pete Mayor: Crist Leads Every Poll
text: St. Pete Polls (Oct 13, n=419, ±4.8) has Crist 50%, Welch 32%, 18% undecided; a later survey cited Oct 26 shows 51-32. Crist finished first in the Aug 18 primary 35%-21%. Caveat: all public polling is from one pollster, some of it sponsored by the pro-Crist committee, and Welch disputes its accuracy. No public polls exist for any other Pinellas local race.
